# Currency Converter Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Review the quality, completeness, and testability of the written requirements for the currency converter feature.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all required supported currencies explicitly named and bounded in scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are all required user input fields and default behaviors clearly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are all required conversion result fields explicitly documented for successful output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are all required fallback behaviors defined for missing daily rates, weekend/holiday dates, and missing currencies? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the offline cache persistence and recovery requirements fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are all invalid amount states and user-facing error cases clearly listed and covered? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the definition of a valid positive amount precise enough to avoid ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the meaning of "latest prior published business date" clearly defined for the user and reviewers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the required behavior when a currency is absent from the official feed unambiguous and non-substitutive? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the distinction between a live feed failure, malformed XML, and cache fallback behavior stated clearly enough to implement consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the requirement that the application "does not crash" made concrete in terms of user-visible behavior and safe fallback messaging? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 - Are the date fallback rules consistent across the scenarios, requirements, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are the cache and offline requirements consistent with the persistence, fallback, and restart expectations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-005, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the validation and conversion requirements consistent with the no-op same-currency rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the success criteria aligned with the requirement to avoid silent substitution of missing currency data? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-004]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 - Are success criteria measurable and objectively testable rather than subjective? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001 to §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are all acceptance scenarios written as observable outcomes rather than describing implementation details? [Acceptance Criteria, User Scenarios & Testing]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are the fallback-date and offline-cache scenarios expressed as verifiable user-visible outcomes? [Acceptance Criteria, User Story 3]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 - Are primary conversion flows covered for both source-target directions? [Coverage, User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are invalid input and required-field states covered across all necessary rejection cases? [Coverage, User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are weekday, weekend, holiday, missing-rate, and missing-currency conditions covered as explicit scenario classes? [Coverage, User Story 3, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are malformed XML, service outage, and absent-cache conditions explicitly included as exception flows? [Coverage, User Story 3, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are restart persistence and offline re-entry scenarios addressed as rollout-ready operational conditions? [Coverage, User Story 3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 - Are stale-cache, empty-response, and invalid-response cases documented as separate edge conditions? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requests with dates newer than the latest published rate or earlier than the earliest known rate explicitly considered? [Edge Case, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are invalid transitions after a prior result, such as changing amount or currency after conversion, treated as defined behavior? [Edge Case, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the requirement for preserving the last valid snapshot after invalid refresh attempts explicit enough to avoid data-loss ambiguity? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-017]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 - Are the required reliability and resilience properties stated in measurable or clearly testable terms? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-005 to §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are data freshness expectations for the official feed and fallback logic stated without relying on implementation assumptions? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-006 to §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are the user-facing constraints around no database server, no login, and no payment processing clearly bounded as out-of-scope requirements? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-015]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK031 - Are the assumptions about local cache availability, official-source access, and persistent storage documented and bounded? [Assumption, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the dependency on the official National Bank of Moldova exchange-rate feed clearly identified and traceable? [Dependency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are all explicit requirements and assumptions free from implementation details that would prematurely lock the solution design? [Assumption, Spec]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK034 - Are there any remaining ambiguous terms or phrases that could still lead to different implementations? [Ambiguity, Spec]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are there any conflicting expectations between explicit fallback behavior and user messaging requirements that need resolution? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are all boundary conditions and exceptions intentionally included rather than left to interpretation? [Gap, Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when the requirement still requires clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- This checklist is intentionally focused on the quality of the requirements, not on implementation correctness.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
